title: 第3章 初识唐三第4章 女孩子要娇养
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
宁苒苒：“你敢伤害我，我爸爸绝对不会放过你的！”
说完闭上了眼睛。
“好啊，我倒要看看，他怎么不放……”
等了好一会儿，印象中的疼痛没有发生，宁苒苒睁开双眼，黑面人倒在地上，不知生死。
眨了眨眼睛，没反应过来。
“你没事吧？”
身后的声音传来，吓了宁苒苒一跳。
她转过头，来人是个跟她一般大的小男孩。
那是个只有五、六岁的孩子，黑色短发看上去很利落，一身衣服虽然朴素，到也干净。
周身气质沉稳，一点也不像是个孩子。
“你没事吧？”
那男孩见宁苒苒没反应，以为她吓傻了，又问了一遍。
“没，没事。”
宁苒苒说完看着男孩，“你好，我叫宁苒苒，谢谢你救了我！”
精致的五官绽开一抹笑意。
“你好，我叫唐三。”
唐三看着眼前长的像个小仙女一样的宁苒苒，忍不住害羞的红了耳尖。
他长这么大，从来没有见过哪个像宁苒苒一样长的那么漂亮的女孩子。
“唐，唐三！
！”

宁苒苒震惊了，不会是她想的那个唐三吧！
唐三：“嗯！
一二三的三。”
唐三以为她听不懂，又解释了一遍。
他将手伸向宁苒苒，想拉她起来，“嘶……”
好痛！
宁苒苒本想站起来，没想到脚腕处一股钻心的疼。
差点又摔倒在地，幸好唐三及时扶住了她。
“看来应该是扭伤了脚，我家就在前面不远处，你要是不介意，我带你回去处理下伤口吧？”
唐三看着她。
宁苒苒：qAq
“好吧，谢谢你。”
实在没办法，宁苒苒同意了。
唐三蹲下，“上来，我背你回去。”
啊咧！
（⊙o⊙）背她！
宁苒苒有些激动，唐三哎！
未来的双神祗，斗罗大陆的男主，竟然要背她！
要知道这可是女主小舞才能拥有的特权，没想到她有生之年竟然可以先享受这种福利！
还有什么是比偶像出现在身边而且还可以近距离接触更幸福的事吗？答案是没有！

唐三心里想，看这小姑娘衣服的料子，怕是家里非富即贵，想来遭了这么大难一时间接受不来，真可怜。
宁苒苒丝毫不知道她在唐三心里已经打上了小可怜的标记。
content_en:
Ning Ranran: "If you dare to hurt me, my father will never let you go!"
After saying that, he closed his eyes.
"Okay, I want to see why he doesn't let go..."
After waiting for a while, the pain in her memory did not occur. Ning Ranran opened her eyes, and the black-faced man fell to the ground, not knowing whether he was alive or dead.
He blinked and didn't react.
"Are you okay?"
The voice from behind startled Ning Ranran.
She turned her head and saw that the person coming was a little boy as big as her.
He was a child of only five or six years old. He had short black hair and looked very neat. Although his clothes were simple, they were also clean.
The whole person has a calm temperament, not like a child at all.
"Are you okay?"
Seeing that Ning Ranran didn't respond, the boy thought she was scared and asked again.
"No, it's okay."
Ning Ranran looked at the boy after saying, "Hello, my name is Ning Ranran, thank you for saving me!"
A smile spread across her delicate facial features.
"Hello, my name is Tang San."
Tang San looked at Ning Ranran who looked like a little fairy in front of him, and couldn't help but the tips of his ears turned red in embarrassment.
In all his life, he has never seen a girl as beautiful as Ning Ranran.
"Tang, Tang San!
! "
Ning Ranran was shocked, it couldn't be the Tang San she thought!
Tang San: "Yeah!
One two three three. "
Tang San thought she didn't understand, so he explained again.
He stretched out his hand to Ning Ranran, trying to pull her up, "Hey..."
It hurts!
Ning Ranran wanted to stand up, but she didn't expect a heartbreaking pain in her ankle.
She almost fell to the ground again, but luckily Tang San caught her in time.
"It seems that you sprained your foot. My house is not far ahead. If you don't mind, can I take you back to treat the wound?"
Tang San looked at her.
Ning Ranran: qAq
"Okay, thank you."
There was really no other way, so Ning Ranran agreed.
Tang San squatted down, "Come up, I'll carry you back."
Ah!
(⊙o⊙) Carry her!
Ning Ranran was a little excited, Tang San!
The two gods of the future, the male protagonist of Douluo Continent, actually want to carry her!
You must know that this is a privilege that the heroine Xiao Wu can only have. I didn't expect that she would be able to enjoy this benefit in her lifetime!
Is there anything happier than having an idol around you and being able to get up close and personal? The answer is no!
Tang San thought to himself, looking at the material of this little girl's clothes, I'm afraid her family is either rich or noble. It's really pitiful that she can't accept such a disaster for a while.
Ning Ranran had no idea that she had marked Tang San's heart as a little pitiful person.
